findings.claim: The universal change-completion command depends on a script that is not created until change 5, making changes 1–4 impossible to execute as specified.
findings.evidence: The plan says under "HOW EVERY CHANGE IS EXECUTED": "T2 at change completion `node --test`, `node rules/build.mjs --check`, `node scripts/spec-validate.mjs`". But change 5 is the first change that creates it: "Scope: `lib/platform/spawn.mjs`, `scripts/spec-validate.mjs`, a `spec:validate` script in `package.json`..." and the cited paths list says "MISSING scripts/spec-validate.mjs".
findings.suggested_fix: For changes before platform-spawn, require the current OpenSpec validation command or the direct local JS entry after change 1; only switch T2 to `node scripts/spec-validate.mjs` after change 5 lands.

findings.claim: The command sequence contradicts the required implementation order by creating `ci-three-os` after changes that depend on it.
findings.evidence: The execution order says "Round 2: ci-three-os" and change 3 depends on it: "Depends on: project-scaffold, ci-three-os"; change 5 also depends on it: "Depends on: project-scaffold (the devDependency), ci-three-os, platform-paths-and-text". But "COMMANDS TO RUN" lists `/opsx:new ci-three-os` fifth, after `/opsx:new platform-paths-and-text`, `/opsx:new platform-atomic-write-and-lock`, and `/opsx:new platform-spawn`.
findings.suggested_fix: Reorder "COMMANDS TO RUN" to match the dependency order: project-scaffold, ci-three-os, platform-paths-and-text, platform-atomic-write-and-lock, platform-spawn, windows-evidence.
